doc.name: AEORank: SEO, AEO & GEO Audit Engine
doc.instructions:
Use AEORank MCP to audit websites for Technical SEO, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO):
1. Call `run_sandbox_audit` with a domain or URL for an instant GEO-62 diagnostic preview.
2. Call `generate_agent_patch_pack` to generate a ready-to-deploy 6-Tab Agentic Patch Pack (/llms.txt, robots.txt, Schema JSON-LD, agent-card.json, _headers, and .geo-answer-box HTML).
3. Call `lookup_rule` to inspect any diagnostic rule (AEO-001..AEO-062) and 9-pillar weights, `list_entity_sources` for DR 70-98 Knowledge Graph platforms, or `search_knowledge_playbooks` for engineering guides.

tools.name: lookup_rule
tools.title: Lookup GEO-62 Rule & Pillar Weight
tools.description: Look up any of the 62 AEORank Technical SEO, AEO & GEO diagnostic rules (e.g. AEO-001..AEO-062, llms_txt, answer_first, entity_clarity) and 9-pillar weights.

query.description: Rule code (e.g. AEO-001), rule ID (e.g. llms_txt_missing), or keyword.

tools.name: list_entity_sources
tools.title: List High-DR Entity & Knowledge Graph Platforms
tools.description: Retrieve verified DR 70-98 self-serve entity & citation platforms (Wikidata, CERN Zenodo DOI, Hugging Face, GitHub, npm, PyPI, LinkedIn) for Knowledge Graph sameAs synchronization.

annotations.title: List High-DR Entity & Knowledge Graph Platforms

category.description: Optional filter (e.g. all, academic, developer, social).

tools.name: search_knowledge_playbooks
tools.title: Search Open Knowledge Hub Playbooks
tools.description: Search peer-reviewed Technical SEO, AEO, and GEO engineering guides from the AEORank Open Knowledge Hub (/learn and /tri-thuc).

query.description: Search keyword (e.g. RAG, llms.txt, Schema, E-E-A-T, Core Web Vitals).

tools.name: run_sandbox_audit
tools.title: Run Sandbox GEO-62 Diagnostic Preview
tools.description: Execute an instant zero-latency ($0) AEORank GEO-62 & Agentic Web 2026 diagnostic preview for a domain or URL.

url.description: Target website URL or domain (e.g. https://example.com).

tools.name: generate_agent_patch_pack
tools.title: Generate 6-Tab Agentic Patch Pack & Remediation Prompt
tools.description: Generate ready-to-deploy machine-readable patch files (/llms.txt, additive RFC 9309 robots.txt, XSS-safe Schema JSON-LD, agent-card.json, safe _headers, and .geo-answer-box Fan-Out HTML) plus a prompt-injection-hardened Coding Agent remediation prompt.

annotations.title: Generate 6-Tab Agentic Patch Pack & Remediation Prompt

url.description: Target website URL or domain (e.g. https://example.com).

scan_token.description: Optional unlocked scan token from aeorank.app to include the full homepage finding list.

lead_token.description: Optional email-verified lead token paired with scan_token.

prompts.name: audit_website_geo_readiness
prompts.title: Audit Website SEO, AEO & GEO Readiness
prompts.description: Run a structured GEO-62 diagnostic preview and generate a 6-Tab Agentic Patch Pack for a target website.

arguments.name: url
arguments.description: Target website URL or domain (e.g. https://example.com).
